name: local-skills
description: Local skills bundle for dotfiles verification, usage audits, code-intel readiness, worktree code-server links, verified local preview servers, work-scope safety, context/cache pressure checks, source provenance, verified handover with optional cmux/purplemux display backends, and runaway agent-process cleanup.

interface.shortDescription: Local dotfiles verification, worktree links, public research, local previews, audit, context-check, handover, Korean prose polish, and claim checks.
interface.longDescription: Repo-local skills for verifying this dotfiles setup, opening git worktrees in browser VS Code, serving generated static artifacts through verified private localhost/LAN/Tailscale preview URLs, auditing local agent usage, checking code-intel readiness, guarding work-scope boundaries, deciding context/cache handoffs, creating verified cross-session handovers, and using cmux or purplemux only as visible display/control backends when requested. Includes verify-output for evidence-first hallucination and claim checks.
defaultPrompt: Verify this dotfiles repo before install.
Give me a Tailscale code-server link for this git worktree.
Serve this generated report with a verified private preview URL.
Audit whether my local agents and skills are actually being used.
Check codegraph and serena readiness for this repo.
Check whether this agent session should continue, compact, clear, or hand over.
Use handover to coordinate a long-running Claude/Codex loop in a visible backend safely.
Hand over this task to fresh Codex and Claude tabs, verify ACK/READY, then close this tab.
Research this public topic with agent-reach and cite the checked sources.
Use hypothesis-debugging to investigate this flaky failure with candidate causes and falsifiable tests.
Use verify-output to audit the previous answer for unsupported claims and produce a corrected version.
Premortem this plan before I commit: assume it already failed and list why, scored by likelihood and impact.
Analyze recent agent JSONL sessions with session-feedback-audit and turn repeated corrections into evidence-backed anti-repeat rules.
Review this Korean technical document with korean-technical-terminology and preserve canonical English terms only when justified.
Humanize this Korean technical README with humanize-korean while preserving code, links, and identifiers.
